meta.name: Oobah: Scams for a Better Tomorrow
meta.description: Oobah Butler sets his sights on the world’s biggest industries and most powerful institutions. To infiltrate the worlds of wine, wellness, royalty, and more, Oobah hatches elaborate and increasingly audacious schemes by gaming online reviews, assuming made-up personas, and launching fake companies with entirely bogus backstories.

videos.title: Wellness
videos.overview: To hack the wellness industry, Oobah concocts a beauty serum made of children's tears and a supplement containing lab-grown human meat.

videos.title: Wine
videos.overview: Oobah attempts to disrupt the wine industry by re-packaging undrinkable smoke-tainted wine as a premium product selling for $500.
